visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Function Changes Only Its Own Pointer
visualizerParams.problemDescription: reset(&score) should set score to 0, but score is still 7 afterwards.

solution.explanation: p = 0 only changes the function's own copy of the pointer so it points nowhere; the caller's variable is untouched. *p = 0 follows the pointer and writes 0 into the variable it points to.
